integrity: Contains an explicit generator derivation and a standalone standard-library deterministic moment checker. The finite checker corroborates, but does not replace, the analytical proof.
scientific_limitations: Positive homogeneous clockwise and counterclockwise quarter-turn rates, four cardinal velocities, a common positive isotropic harmonic relaxation, optional independent isotropic Gaussian translational noise. No nonlinear traps or arbitrary orientation memory. The exact formulas are proven analytically and tested on finite parameter grids; priority beyond examined literature remains uncertain.
title: A fourth-order chirality fingerprint and exact factorization boundary for harmonically trapped four-state swimmers
